For the SettingsModal, I'm integrating Yandex into the dropdown and ensuring the animation class is applied. I'm verifying the animation is supported in the CSS.


**Refining Settings Modal Animation**

I'm revisiting the Settings Modal animation, aiming to make it more noticeable. I will add `animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300` to the existing code to improve the visual effect. I'm verifying that the search engine is correctly passed through to the underlying search implementation.


**Adding Yandex to Settings**

I'm now integrating Yandex as a selectable search option within the SettingsModal. I've updated the `constants.tsx` to include the correct URL. Also, I've adjusted the `<select>` options in `components/SettingsModal.tsx`, making Yandex available in the search engine dropdown, ensuring the user can choose it.
